desc: Position Overview: At Madison Technologies, we don't just deliver reports; we operate as a seamless extension of our client's internal teams. Your goal is to move from being a "task-taker" to a "trusted advisor" who understands their business as well as they do. We are seeking a technically proficient and business-savvy Data Analyst to join our team at Madison Technologies. This role is designed…
full:
Position Overview:
At Madison Technologies, we don't just deliver reports; we operate as a seamless extension of our client's internal teams.
Your goal is to move from being a "task-taker" to a "trusted advisor" who understands their business as well as they do.
We are seeking a technically proficient and business-savvy Data Analyst to join our team at Madison Technologies.
This role is designed for an individual who can bridge the gap between complex data engineering and strategic business growth.
You will leverage modern data platforms and AI to optimize core business metrics and automate manual workflows, ensuring we deliver high-impact results for our global clients.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Finance Data and ERP Readiness
Finance Current-State Assessment: Interview the chief accountant and finance teams to map how exchange rates, timezones and COD (cash-on-delivery) reconciliation are handled today, and set a baseline for current reconciliation time.
Odoo Data Design: Define the data format, schema and table list needed to feed the Data Warehouse into Odoo, including a single FX source, matching keys, COD thresholds, chart of accounts and multi-company setup.
Automated Reconciliation: Design rules for order-level reconciliation so margin can be tracked by SKU, channel and campaign, and COD losses go down.
2. Single Source of Truth and Business Glossary
Metric Inventory: Extract every measure and calculated field from Power BI, Looker Studio, Lark and Google Sheets, compare them for the same period in SQL, and find the root cause of the top 10 mismatched metrics.
Business Glossary: Build and get owner sign-off on the first 20–30 core metrics (ROAS, CPA, CVR, COGS, gross profit, margin), each with definition, formula, grain and owner, plus one agreed attribution model, committed as version-controlled dbt YAML.
Partner Reporting: Rebuild the definition of the monthly partner report (metrics, formulas, grain, tenant) so it can be fully automated in a multi-tenant setup.
Suggested Metrics and Reports: Propose department-level metric marts and executive KPIs, each with a measured baseline, so the program can show real business impact.
3. Business Discovery and Stakeholder Management
Multi-Market Interviews: Run structured business interviews with HQ and each of the 9 markets, and send meeting minutes within 24 hours.
Business Growth Strategy: Lay the groundwork for customer profiling, RFM segmentation and cohort analysis to support retargeting, repeat purchase and lifetime value growth.
Progress Reporting: Report OKR status (on track, at risk, off track) in weekly client meetings and contribute to the final readout and go/no-go recommendation.
Qualifications:
Experience: 3+ years as a Data Analyst or Business Analyst, ideally in e-commerce, retail or fintech, or with a bachelor's degree in a related quantitative field.
Advanced SQL: Expert-level ability to write complex queries on BigQuery (window functions, CTEs, reconciliation queries) to compare and validate numbers across sources.
Programming: Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
Executive Visualization: Proficiency in Power BI (DAX) and Looker Studio, including reverse-engineering existing dashboards into clear, KPI-focused tools for C-level stakeholders.
Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with BigQuery. Familiarity with dbt (YAML, metrics) and Git, and experience building a business glossary or semantic layer, is a plus.
Product and Marketing Analytics: Hands-on experience with ROAS, CPA, CVR, attribution models and ad platform data (Meta and others); exposure to RFM, churn and LTV analysis is a plus.
Integrated Business Systems: Understanding of revenue recognition, multi currency accounting, COD flows and margin calculation.
Experience with Odoo or another ERP, Pancake or Lark/Larkbase is a strong plus.
Linguistic Proficiency: Native Vietnamese for business interviews, plus excellent command of English (both written and verbal), ability to present data narratives to stakeholders.
Location: Based at our Da Nang office.
Why Join Madison Technologies:
Global Exposure: Partner directly with clients across the US, EU and SEA, delivering high-impact solutions in an elite international environment.
Diverse Domain Mastery: Rapidly expand your toolkit by solving complex data challenges across various industries from Healthcare, Fintech, E-commerce.
Income/Benefit:
Competitive salary package (negotiable based on experience).
Opportunity for long-term growth in a leadership role.
Contact Information:
If you are interested in this opportunity, please send your CV to: recruitment@madison.dev
For more information about us: https://madison-technologies.com/

Yêu cầu
Experience: 3+ years as a Data Analyst or Business Analyst, ideally in e-commerce, retail or fintech, or with a bachelor's degree in a related quantitative field.
Advanced SQL: Expert-level ability to write complex queries on BigQuery (window functions, CTEs, reconciliation queries) to compare and validate numbers across sources.
Programming: Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
Executive Visualization: Proficiency in Power BI (DAX) and Looker Studio, including reverse-engineering existing dashboards into clear, KPI-focused tools for C-level stakeholders.
Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with BigQuery. Familiarity with dbt (YAML, metrics) and Git, and experience building a business glossary or semantic layer, is a plus.
Product and Marketing Analytics: Hands-on experience with ROAS, CPA, CVR, attribution models and ad platform data (Meta and others); exposure to RFM, churn and LTV analysis is a plus.
Integrated Business Systems: Understanding of revenue recognition, multi currency accounting, COD flows and margin calculation.
Experience with Odoo or another ERP, Pancake or Lark/Larkbase is a strong plus.
Quyền lợi
Global Exposure: Partner directly with clients across the US, EU and SEA, delivering high-impact solutions in an elite international environment.
Diverse Domain Mastery: Rapidly expand your toolkit by solving complex data challenges across various industries from Healthcare, Fintech, E-commerce.
Income/Benefit:
Competitive salary package (negotiable based on experience).
Opportunity for long-term growth in a leadership role.

full:
A) Mô tả công việc
1. Triển khai & Tối ưu Giải pháp Dữ liệu (60% - Hands-on)
Dự án End-to-End: Trực tiếp chủ trì và xắn tay áo triển khai các dự án dữ liệu từ thu thập, làm sạch, đến xây dựng mô hình và A/B testing.
Xây dựng Mô hình Chuyên sâu: Phát triển và tinh chỉnh (fine-tune) các mô hình ML (Phân loại, Hồi quy, Chuỗi thời gian...) để giải quyết các bài toán kinh doanh trọng yếu:
Customer Scoring phục vụ Upsell / Cross-sell.
Phân khúc khách hàng (Segmentation) nâng cao hiệu quả Marketing.
Dự báo Churn, đo lường LTV và thiết kế chiến lược Giữ chân khách hàng (Retention).
Kiểm soát Chất lượng: Đánh giá nghiêm ngặt hiệu suất mô hình và tính chính xác của dữ liệu trước khi áp dụng vào vận hành.
2. Dẫn dắt Team Nhỏ & Phối hợp Liên phòng ban (20%)
Dẫn dắt, phân công công việc và hỗ trợ chuyên môn cho nhóm nhỏ (Data Analysts / Engineers).
Phối hợp với đội ngũ Kỹ thuật/AI/ML để chuẩn hóa dòng chảy dữ liệu và hạ tầng phân tích.
3. Cố vấn Kinh doanh & Data Storytelling (20%)
Làm việc trực tiếp với Product Owners, Marketing, Sales để dịch chuyển bài toán kinh doanh thành chỉ số (Metrics) và giả thuyết có thể đo lường.
Chuyển hóa dữ liệu thành bức tranh trực quan, dễ hiểu (Data Storytelling) giúp Ban Lãnh đạo và các bộ phận ra quyết định chính xác.
B) Yêu cầu ứng viên
Học vấn: Cử nhân trở lên các chuyên ngành Khoa học dữ liệu, Thống kê, Toán tin, CNTT, Kinh tế lượng hoặc liên quan.
Kinh nghiệm:
Tối thiểu 3 - 5 năm kinh nghiệm làm về Data Analytics / Data Science.
Có kinh nghiệm Lead nhóm nhỏ và chủ trì (Ownership) các dự án dữ liệu liên phòng ban.
Ưu tiên ứng viên từng làm tại các công ty Product, E-commerce, Fintech, SaaS, Scale-up Tech.
Kỹ thuật: Thành thạo SQL, Python/R, các công cụ Visualization (Tableau/PowerBI/Looker), nắm vững Machine Learning và A/B Testing. Khai thác tốt dữ liệu từ CRM, LMS, Telesale, Marketing.
Tư duy: Tư duy kinh doanh sắc bén (Business Acumen), khả năng giải quyết vấn đề tốt với dữ liệu thô, giao tiếp mạch lạc và có tinh thần trách nhiệm cao đối với kết quả đầu ra.
C) Quyền lợi ứng viên
Tinh thần:
Làm việc trong môi trường start-up có tốc độ tăng trưởng và phát triển nhanh.
Được chia sẻ cơ hội học tập chất lượng cao đến trẻ em toàn Việt Nam
Môi trường làm việc: Trẻ trung, năng động, khát vọng Go Global, tự do sáng tạo, chú trọng phát triển con người & phát triển sự nghiệp của các thành viên trong công ty.
Chế độ phúc lợi:
Lương cạnh tranh upto 40 triệu + Thưởng KPI. Thu nhập từ 45 - 55 triệu/tháng.
Lương tháng 13, thưởng cuối năm theo kết quả kinh doanh chung của Công ty.
Được đóng BHXH đầy đủ theo luật lao động, nghỉ phép 12 ngày/năm và các ngày lễ theo quy định chung
Được đi du lịch hằng năm với địa điểm hấp dẫn, thường xuyên tổ chức các hoạt động team building gắn kết cộng đồng, các hoạt động vui chơi giải trí cho nhân viên.
Được tham gia các buổi liên hoan, sinh nhật hàng tháng, chương trình gala cuối năm...
Được thử sức trong một môi trường làm việc trẻ trung, năng động với chính sách đãi ngộ tốt, có nhiều cơ hội nâng cao năng lực bản thân và tăng thêm thu nhập.

Địa điểm làm việc
Hà Nội: Tòa Comatce, 61 Ngụy Như Kon Tum, Phường Thanh Xuân (Phường Thanh Xuân thuộc quận Thanh Xuân cũ)
Thời gian làm việc
Thứ 2 - Thứ 6 (từ 08:00 đến 17:30)
Thứ 7 (từ 08:00 đến 12:00)

full:
📌 Job Title: SENIOR DATA ENGINEER
📍 Location: Vietnam
🕒 Type: Full Time
📂 Department:
Job Summary:
For one of our clients, we are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join our dynamic team.
The ideal candidate will have a solid background in data engineering, with expertise in Python, ETL tools, Airflow, and Hadoop.
You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines that handle high-volume transactions exceeding 50 million per day.
If you're excited about solving challenging problems, delivering polished user experiences, and contributing to a fast-paced and innovative environment, we’d love to meet you.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models for large transaction systems.
Utilize Python and ETL tools to extract, transform, and load data efficiently from various sources.
Implement and manage workflows using Apache Airflow to automate data processing tasks.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and ensure data quality and availability.
Optimize data processing performance and reliability in a Hadoop environment.
Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline issues to ensure operational efficiency and reliability.
Document processes, data flow, and architecture for future reference and compliance.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data engineering.
Required Qualifications:
MUST HAVE
6+ years of experience in data engineering or a similar role.
Strong proficiency in Python for data processing and manipulation.
Hands-on experience with ETL tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica, Apache NiFi).
In-depth knowledge of Apache Airflow for workflow management.
Experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop and its ecosystem (e.g., HDFS, Hive, Spark).
Proven experience in building and maintaining big transaction systems (handling over 50 million transactions per day).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

full:
YOUR NEW ROLE
This role is for CODE LEAP's client company - JTL-Software
JTL-Software is one of Germany's leading providers of e-commerce and ERP solutions.
More than 50,000 retailers rely on JTL every day to run their business.
Our global development center in Vietnam is looking for talented people to build the next generation of these products.
You'll work in an international team that pairs German software quality and Vietnamese speed to innovate.
Tens of thousands of merchants run their business on JTL.
Their data, every order, article and stock movement, is spread across thousands of local systems, where it works for no one.
We are changing that.
The Customer Data Platform brings merchant data into the cloud, securely and with permission, and turns it into answers merchants can act on.
It is the foundation beneath our new BI product, our AI agent Juno and every data product JTL will build next.
A first version already runs end to end.
Now we are taking it from a handful of pilot merchants to a foundation built for thousands.
We are a new, small and senior team with a clear mandate, a modern stack (Python, DuckDB, dbt, PostgreSQL, Dagster, Azure, Terraform) and an AI-native way of working: specs and decision records first, coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex doing much of the implementation, humans owning design, review and judgement.
You own the data path: from the moment a merchant's delivery arrives, through validation and nightly builds, to versioned business views that products can trust.
Nothing lost, nothing counted twice, no half finished state ever visible, for thousands of merchants at once.
We are hiring two Data Engineers with complementary profiles, from Mid-Level to Staff, and set the level with you, based on your experience.
The team spans Germany and Vietnam: two senior engineering leaders in Germany and three engineers in Ho Chi Minh City.
You will work directly with the German leads, with our internal data team and with the product teams that build on the platform.
Working language is English; we work asynchronously by default and meet daily in a shared overlap window.
YOUR EXCITING TASKS
Design and build tenant-isolated transformation layers with dbt and DuckDB, from raw deliveries to clean, versioned business views.
Define data contracts for ERP source tables (orders, articles, stock, invoices) and extend them to new sources step by step.
Build idempotent, replayable pipelines: deliveries may arrive twice, results never do.
Orchestrate nightly runs per merchant with Dagster, with retries, blast-radius limits and alerts that say what happened.
Automate data quality and end-to-end checks into every pull request.
Model the metrics products ask for, revenue, margin, stock, reorder signals, together with the product teams.
Work agent-first: specify, then let Claude Code and Codex implement, orchestrate agents across pipelines and models, triage pipeline issues with them, and own the review.
Keep cost per merchant transparent and low.
YOUR PROFILE AND YOUR PERSONALITY
8+ years building production data pipelines.
Excellent SQL and strong Python; you can read a query plan and you test what you ship.
Hands-on experience with dbt (or comparable) and analytical engines such as DuckDB, Spark, Snowflake or BigQuery.
Experience with an orchestrator such as Dagster or Airflow.
A solid grasp of analytical data modelling: incremental loads, idempotency, late and duplicate deliveries.
Experience with relational sources (Microsoft SQL Server or similar) and PostgreSQL.
Hands-on, daily experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex: you design agent workflows, orchestrate agents on real work and know when not to trust them.
Clear written and spoken English and a habit of writing things down.
Nice To Have
Multi-tenant data platforms, tenant isolation and row-level security.
Data contracts and schema evolution.
Terraform, Azure or GitHub Actions.
Semantic or metrics layers (MetricFlow, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube).
Building agent tooling: MCP servers, custom skills, agent evals, automated issue triage or AI-assisted data operations.
E-commerce or ERP data.
Benefits Await You At Code Leap
Competitive salary and beneﬁts
Year-end bonus (13th-month salary)
Generous annual leave of up to 18 days
Additional premium health insurance
Enjoy an endless selection of delicious refreshments, including gourmet coffee, beverages, snacks, and fresh fruits, all complimentary
Dynamic, fun, and agile environment, perfect for sharing and creativity
Open-minded, kind & humble colleagues
CONTACT
Come to talk to us at jobs@codeleap.de
About Us
With our expert teams spread across two continents, CODE LEAP provides innovative software solutions for venture-backed companies and leading enterprise businesses in Germany.
Our teams in Berlin (Germany) and Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam) work hand in hand to develop state-of-the-art solutions of the highest quality.
Because collaborating with the right people is the secret to our successful growth.
We future-proof organizations - be part of it!

full:
Working location: Remote full-time (09:00 - 18:00 ICT)
Salary range: USD 4,000 - 8,000 gross
RESPONSIBILITIES
We are looking for a senior applied data scientist or quantitative researcher to lead the development and continuous improvement of the predictive models and statistical frameworks behind our real-time forecasting engines, beginning with eSports.
You will apply probabilistic modelling, machine learning and rigorous validation to live, high-frequency data, then work closely with our engineers to move that research into production.
You will join the Quantitative Research team, reporting to our CTO.
Our Head Quantitative Strategist will guide research priorities and methodology.
You will own the modelling approach and ongoing model performance.
As you develop deeper domain and data expertise, you will take greater responsibility for development priorities and help shape the direction of future research.
Design, build and optimise the machine learning models and statistical frameworks that power our real-time eSports forecasting.
Extract deep predictive signals from raw, high-frequency data streams, starting with live eSports telemetry, turning complex in-game mechanics into structured modelling features.
Focus on model performance and probability calibration. Design rigorous backtesting frameworks to prevent data leakage and evaluate performance against historical forecasting benchmarks.
Build the probabilistic framework that turns live game-state and event-level predictions into consistent forecasts for game, round and match outcomes, score differences, aggregate game statistics and player performance.
Ensure your models are translated seamlessly into production-grade pipelines and microservices.
REQUIREMENTS
At least 5 years of professional experience in data science, quantitative research or statistical modelling, including ownership of complex modelling work.
Strong applied knowledge of probability and statistics, demonstrated through probabilistic modelling, calibration or comparable quantitative work.
Strong Python skills and experience writing clean, maintainable research and production code.
Proven experience designing rigorous backtesting or temporal validation environments, preventing data leakage and defining evaluation metrics for unusual business problems.
Nice to have
Experience applying probabilistic models in quantitative trading, market-making, forecasting, sports or eSports, particularly where calibrated probabilities have direct commercial value.
Experience modelling streaming data or other data that changes continuously over time.
Deep knowledge of competitive eSports, especially Counter-Strike 2, Dota 2 or League of Legends, including the underlying game mechanics and competitive meta.
An understanding of modern MLOps principles and experience with tools such as MLflow or Airflow.

full:
Job Title: Data Analytics
Location: ADG Tower, 37 Le Van Thiem Street, Nhan Chinh Ward, Thanh Xuan District, Hanoi
Department: Technology
Working Hours: Full-time, Check-in 8-9h, check-out 17-18h, T2-T6
Get To Know Gimo
Are you an enthusiastic, young-at-heart individual who thrives in a fast-paced work environment with a dynamic team?
Are you passionate about advancing your career in the fintech industry?
If so, Gimo is the right place for you.
At Gimo, we are on a mission to make financial access easier for millions of workers across Vietnam and SEA.
As a pioneer in Earned Wage Access (EWA), we’re changing the way employees get paid - giving them instant access to their earnings and reducing financial stress for those who need it most.
But we’re not stopping there.
By understanding the real challenges workers face, we are creating practical and responsible financial solutions that help improve their daily lives.
Today, over 700,000 employees from 100+ businesses trust Gimo to take control of their finances, and this number is growing every day.
By joining us, you will be part of a team that is shaping a future where financial security is within reach for everyone.
Let’s build something meaningful together.
Key Responsibilities
Work closely with relevant business functions to understand the domain and data structure
Contribute to the solution of various data migration, data modeling, data validation and governance
Coordinate with stakeholders to understand the data requirements such as user insights, customer journeys, business metrics; translating business requests to meaningful data implementation; perform corresponding analysis to develop datasets, reports, and dashboards using BI tools
Analyze data for trends and patterns to support business strategic planning
Collaborate with data engineers to develop efficient frameworks and tools for data quality and data lineage
Coach business users to get familiar with BI reports
Perform data audit to identify the cause of mismatched data between systems when needed
Key Qualifications & Experience
2 - 5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or related fields
Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Engineering, Computer Science, or similar majors
Expert in SQL is a must
Intermediate hands-on with at least one of the programming languages: Python, R
Solid experience in designing and working with data warehouses, data marts, and aggregation tables using platforms like AWS Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and MySQL
Familiar with dimensional data modeling for scalable analytics solutions
Proficient in Power BI and other visualization tools such as Metabase, Looker, or Tableau
Experience with data cleansing, data transformation, data quality assessment, and statistical analytics
Good foundation with version control (Git), CI/CD concepts (Docker, Jenkins) and Cloud Computing (AWS, GCP, etc.)
Mentorship and knowledge sharing mindset, able to guide junior data analysts
Nice to have:
Practical knowledge transforming data using dbt (Data Build Tool)
Experience with some forms of Intelligent Credit Scoring implementation
Familiar with building Semantic Layer for data platform (Cube, AtScale, etc.)
Proven abilities to work collaboratively under Agile/Scrum working environments
Experience with AI-assisted tools to automate data workflows and architect complex data model
Why Join Gimo?
Impact-Driven Work: Be part of a mission-driven fintech company that is transforming financial access for millions of Vietnamese underserved
Growth Opportunities: Work in a fast-growth environment that values growth, autonomy, accountability and empowering individuals to take initiative and make decisions
Innovative Culture: Join the team that embraces innovation, data, technology to drive solutions.
Be part of the company that encourages experimentation, collaboration and drive to challenge the status quo
Competitive compensation: Attractive base salary with yearly and holiday bonuses
Comprehensive benefits: Full participation in social insurance as per regulations, PTI health insurance, free parking, and various other perks such as annual leave, birthday gifts, and team-building activities
How to apply
If you are excited, send your CV to linhdn@gimo.vn with the subject line: Application for [Job Title] – [Your Name].
We look forward to having you on board and growing together at Gimo!

Our website: https://Gimo.vn/

full:
CHI TIẾT CÔNG VIỆC
Xây dựng và vận hành data pipeline: ingest sự kiện hành vi người dùng từ Kafka và các nguồn batch vào data warehouse.
Thiết kế & tối ưu model dữ liệu trên ClickHouse (user profile, attribute, event aggregate) — đảm bảo query chạy trong thời gian chấp nhận được ở quy mô chục triệu user.
Tích hợp với các service nội bộ khác qua interface trừu tượng, không hard-code provider.
Viết & vận hành Airflow DAG cho các job chạy định kỳ, export dữ liệu ra hệ thống bên ngoài (hash PII trước khi gửi).
Đảm bảo chất lượng: unit/integration test, code review, migration DB có kiểm soát, monitoring & alert cho pipeline.
Tham gia thiết kế: đọc/viết design doc (HLA, ERD), phản biện phương án, ghi lại quyết định kỹ thuật.
YÊU CẦU CÔNG VIỆC
3–4 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí Data Engineer
SQL tốt — không chỉ viết được query, mà đọc được execution plan và biết vì sao một query chậm.
Kinh nghiệm thực tế với ít nhất một analytical database (ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, Druid…) và một RDBMS (PostgreSQL / MySQL).
Có kinh nghiệm với workflow orchestration (Airflow / Dagster / Prefect): dependency, backfill, idempotency.
Kinh nghiệm Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitLab CI), Infrastructure as Code.
Biết Spark / Flink hoặc xử lý dữ liệu quy mô lớn.
Từng làm sản phẩm B2C có traffic lớn (OTT, e-commerce, fintech).
Có ý thức về data privacy / PII (hashing, consent, opt-out).
QUYỀN LỢI
Gói thu nhập năm tương xứng với năng lực (13 tháng lương, nghỉ mát...)
Làm việc trong môi trường năng động, chuyên nghiệp có nhiều cơ hội thăng tiến.
Cung cấp trang thiết bị đầy đủ để phục vụ công việc.
Văn hóa doanh nghiệp đa dạng, phong phú; các hoạt động tri ân, chăm lo đời sống tinh thần Cán bộ nhân viên và người thân, Teambuilding, Ngày hội văn hóa, các Câu lạc bộ...
Tham gia đầy đủ các chế độ theo Luật lao động hiện hành (BHXH, BHYT, BHTN, ngày phép); Khám sức khỏe định kỳ, nghỉ hè hàng năm; Gói bảo hiểm sức khỏe chuyên biệt FPT Care.
Được tham gia các khóa đào tạo, nâng cao nghiệp vụ thường xuyên.
Hưởng các gói ưu đãi cước khi sử dụng dịch vụ của FPT Play.

full:
Job Description
ABOUT THE JOB
Contribute to the migration of data workflows from Google BigQuery to Databricks.
Develop, maintain, and optimise data pipelines using Python and PySpark.
Write and optimise advanced SQL queries to process and analyse large volumes of e-commerce data.
Perform data extraction, transformation, processing, and validation across multiple data sources.
Clean and structure high-volume datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability.
Support the design and implementation of reliable data-processing workflows in Databricks.
Develop and maintain Microsoft Power BI dashboards and reports based on processed data.
Investigate data-quality issues, troubleshoot pipeline errors, and improve query and processing performance.
Document data workflows, transformation logic, and technical processes.

International working environment

Equal Opportunity

For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.
Who are we?
Amaris Consulting, part of Mantu is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses.
With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries.

We look forward to meeting you!

Mô tả công việc
1. Triển khai & Tối ưu Giải pháp Dữ liệu (60% - Hands-on)
Dự án End-to-End: Trực tiếp chủ trì và xắn tay áo triển khai các dự án dữ liệu từ thu thập, làm sạch, đến xây dựng mô hình và A/B testing.
Xây dựng Mô hình Chuyên sâu: Phát triển và tinh chỉnh (fine-tune) các mô hình ML (Phân loại, Hồi quy, Chuỗi thời gian...) để giải quyết các bài toán kinh doanh trọng yếu:
Customer Scoring phục vụ Upsell / Cross-sell.
Phân khúc khách hàng (Segmentation) nâng cao hiệu quả Marketing.
Dự báo Churn, đo lường LTV và thiết kế chiến lược Giữ chân khách hàng (Retention).
Kiểm soát Chất lượng: Đánh giá nghiêm ngặt hiệu suất mô hình và tính chính xác của dữ liệu trước khi áp dụng vào vận hành.
2. Dẫn dắt Team Nhỏ & Phối hợp Liên phòng ban (20%)
Dẫn dắt, phân công công việc và hỗ trợ chuyên môn cho nhóm nhỏ (Data Analysts / Engineers).
Phối hợp với đội ngũ Kỹ thuật/AI/ML để chuẩn hóa dòng chảy dữ liệu và hạ tầng phân tích.
3. Cố vấn Kinh doanh & Data Storytelling (20%)
Làm việc trực tiếp với Product Owners, Marketing, Sales để dịch chuyển bài toán kinh doanh thành chỉ số (Metrics) và giả thuyết có thể đo lường.
Chuyển hóa dữ liệu thành bức tranh trực quan, dễ hiểu (Data Storytelling) giúp Ban Lãnh đạo và các bộ phận ra quyết định chính xác.

Học vấn: Cử nhân trở lên các chuyên ngành Khoa học dữ liệu, Thống kê, Toán tin, CNTT, Kinh tế lượng hoặc liên quan.
Kinh nghiệm:
Tối thiểu 3 - 5 năm kinh nghiệm làm về Data Analytics / Data Science.
Có kinh nghiệm Lead nhóm nhỏ và chủ trì (Ownership) các dự án dữ liệu liên phòng ban.
Ưu tiên ứng viên từng làm tại các công ty Product, E-commerce, Fintech, SaaS, Scale-up Tech.
Kỹ thuật: Thành thạo SQL, Python/R, các công cụ Visualization (Tableau/PowerBI/Looker), nắm vững Machine Learning và A/B Testing. Khai thác tốt dữ liệu từ CRM, LMS, Telesale, Marketing.
Tư duy: Tư duy kinh doanh sắc bén (Business Acumen), khả năng giải quyết vấn đề tốt với dữ liệu thô, giao tiếp mạch lạc và có tinh thần trách nhiệm cao đối với kết quả đầu ra.
Quyền lợi ứng viên
Tinh thần:
Làm việc trong môi trường start-up có tốc độ tăng trưởng và phát triển nhanh.
Được chia sẻ cơ hội học tập chất lượng cao đến trẻ em toàn Việt Nam
Môi trường làm việc: Trẻ trung, năng động, khát vọng Go Global, tự do sáng tạo, chú trọng phát triển con người & phát triển sự nghiệp của các thành viên trong công ty.
Chế độ phúc lợi:
Lương cạnh tranh upto 40 triệu + Thưởng KPI. Thu nhập từ 45 - 55 triệu/tháng.
Lương tháng 13, thưởng cuối năm theo kết quả kinh doanh chung của Công ty.
Được đóng BHXH đầy đủ theo luật lao động, nghỉ phép 12 ngày/năm và các ngày lễ theo quy định chung

Được tham gia các buổi liên hoan, sinh nhật hàng tháng, chương trình gala cuối năm...
Được thử sức trong một môi trường làm việc trẻ trung, năng động với chính sách đãi ngộ tốt, có nhiều cơ hội nâng cao năng lực bản thân và tăng thêm thu nhập.

full:
In accordance with the applicable laws and regulations on personal data protection, including the Law on Personal Data Protection and its implementing regulations, Home Credit Vietnam Finance Company Limited (“Home Credit”) collects and processes candidates’ personal data for recruitment purposes and other related purposes in accordance with the Agreement, Notice and Acceptance for Personal Data Processing.
By submitting your application to Home Credit through Linkedin , you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agreed to the contents of the Agreement, Notice and Acceptance for Personal Data Processing available at the following link: AGREEMENT, NOTICE, ACCEPTANCE FOR PERSONAL DATA PROCESSING, and consent to Home Credit collecting and processing your personal data in accordance with applicable laws and regulations
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Work directly with business users to gather requirements, clarify business logic and propose suitable data solutions.
Design data models for reporting: define grain, metrics and dimensions, and implement them as maintainable dbt projects.
Build and own streaming and batch pipelines from Kafka and source databases into the warehouse and data marts, using Airflow, dbt, and Postgres.
Migrate data, business logic and reports from the legacy data warehouse to the new platform, including backfill, parallel run, reconciliation, cutover and rollback.
Deliver new data features and products end to end, from design to deployment and handover.
Deploy pipelines and services through GitLab CI following GitOps practices; keep all changes version-controlled and reviewed.
Monitor pipelines and data quality daily (tests, freshness, reconciliation, alerts); troubleshoot incidents and fix root causes.
Tune performance of SQL queries, dbt models and Airflow jobs.
Join on-call rotation for critical data products.
Maintain documentation: data models, lineage, runbooks, architecture diagrams.
Mentor team members through code review, design review and pairing; set and maintain team standards for modeling, dbt and CI/CD.
JOB REQUIREMENTS
5+ years in data engineering, including 3+ years running dbt and Airflow in production.
Has designed and owned at least one data platform component or data product end to end.
Has led or played a key role in at least one migration from a legacy data warehouse to a new platform.
Experience working with on-premise or self-hosted data platforms (not only managed cloud services)
Technical expertise:
Data modeling (advanced): dimensional modeling (Kimball, star/snowflake schema, SCD types, fact table design, grain definition). Designs models that stay stable as business requirements change.
Dbt Core (advanced): project structure (staging/intermediate/marts), incremental models, snapshots, macros and Jinja, packages, tests and documentation; orchestrates dbt runs with Airflow and sets up CI in GitLab (e.g.
slim CI using manifest/state artifacts); optimizes model performance and run time
GitOps & CI/CD (advanced): branching and merge request workflow, automated testing and environment promotion in GitLab CI; declarative deployments on Kubernetes (Helm, ArgoCD or equivalent).
Data migration (advanced): assesses and re-implements legacy transformation logic, backfills historical data, runs old and new systems in parallel, reconciles results, and plans cutover and rollback.
SQL & Postgres (advanced): writes complex analytical SQL (window functions, CTEs, incremental logic); reads query plans and tunes indexes, partitioning and queries for reporting workloads.
Kafka (proficient): creates and configures topics; builds producers and consumers in production; understands partitioning, consumer groups, offsets and schema management; handles late, duplicate or out-of-order events.
Python (proficient): writes production-quality code for pipelines and tooling (structured, tested, reusable); builds custom Airflow operators and hooks.
Kubernetes (proficient): deploys and runs data workloads as pods: resource sizing, config and secrets, reading logs and troubleshooting failures. Cluster administration not required.
Soft skills
Takes ownership of problems through to resolution, not just the assigned task.
Communicates clearly with non-technical business users; able to challenge requirements and explain trade-offs.
Willing and able to mentor less experienced engineers.
English: communicates confidently in both speaking and writing with foreign colleagues, including technical discussions and documentation.
Nice to have
Banking, fintech or payments domain; knowledge of SBV regulations.
Spark.
Grafana, Prometheus.
Data governance: classification, masking, access audit.
Education
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or related fields (preferred).
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
13th Salary Fixed and KPI Bonus
Premium Health Care program
24/7 Accidental Insurance
100% Social Insurance
Meal + Phone Allowance
Yearly Medical Checkup
Professional and Transparent Working Environment

full:
About Safetrust
Safetrust is building the future of identity.
Imagine a world where your phone, wearable, or digital credential becomes your secure key—unlocking buildings, systems, and experiences seamlessly across physical and digital environments.
That’s what we do.
Our platform combines IoT devices, mobile credentials, and cloud-native architecture to power secure access for Fortune 200 companies and global enterprises.
As we evolve from a hardware-centric model to a platform and services-driven business, marketing plays a critical role in shaping how the market understands—and adopts—Safetrust.
About the role:
The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for the performance, efficiency, and scalability of Safetrust’s databases, data warehouse, and data pipelines.
This is a specialized, individual contributor role focused on performance tuning, ensuring that our data systems run fast, reliably, and cost-effectively as data volumes and usage grow.
Working alongside our software engineering and dev ops teams with a high degree of ownership, the Senior Data Engineer will diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across SQL queries, database workloads, and ETL/ELT jobs – from investigation and benchmarking through to implementation and validation.
The position is critical in supporting Safetrust’s continued growth by improving system responsiveness, reducing platform costs, and keeping our data infrastructure ready to scale.
Key Responsibilities:
Query & Database Performance Tuning
Analyze and optimize resource-intensive SQL queries and database workloads using execution plans and profiling.
Tune relational databases through indexing, partitioning, statistics, and configuration, and resolve locking and concurrency issues.
Validate every improvement through before/after benchmarking to ensure measurable gains with no regression.
Data Pipeline Performance
Identify and resolve bottlenecks in existing ETL/ELT pipelines affecting throughput, latency, and data freshness.
Optimize jobs through incremental loading, efficient transformation logic, and improved scheduling.
Test and deploy performance changes safely, with minimal disruption to downstream reports and applications.
Performance Monitoring & Reporting
Establish performance baselines, KPIs, and monitoring/alerting for critical queries, databases, and pipelines.
Proactively detect performance degradation and lead root-cause analysis for performance-related incidents.
Document tuning changes and best practices, and communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
Skills & Experience:
5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Database Engineering, or Database Administration, with a strong focus on performance tuning and optimization
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Expert-level SQL skills, with proven experience reading execution plans and optimizing complex queries on large datasets
Experience optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines and working with orchestration/transformation tools (e.g., dbt, Airflow, or similar); proficiency in Python
Experience with monitoring and observability tools for databases and data systems
Proven track record of independently diagnosing and resolving performance issues in production environments
Hands-on experience tuning Snowflake (preferred) or similar cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift, including warehouse tuning and cost management, is a plus.
Experience in SaaS, IoT, cybersecurity, identity management, or access control industries is a plus
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment
Success Profile:
The ideal candidate is:
Self-directed and highly accountable – able to own work end-to-end with minimal supervision
Performance-obsessed and data-driven – measures before and after, and lets evidence guide optimization decisions
Hands-on and detail-oriented, comfortable going deep into query plans, database internals, and platform settings
Able to translate technical findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for both technical and business stakeholders
Comfortable working across regions and functions in a global environment
Why you'll love working here
Competitive salary based on experience and performance
Daily lunch is provided at the office
Free coffee, tea, and refreshments
Full statutory insurance (social, health, unemployment)
Annual health check-up and paid annual leaves
Professional, international working environment
Working Location: Level 6 Khanh Hoi 2 Building 360A Ben Van Don, Vinh Hoi, Ho Chi Minh City
Safetrust is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.
We offer an inclusive workplace and will not tolerate discrimination against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status or parental status.

ABOUT BUZZMETRICS
Buzzmetrics, a member of YouNet Group, is a leading Social Media & E-commerce Market Research company for Marketing Systems.
Since 2013, Buzzmetrics has pioneered the application of market research methodologies to social media and digital environments, helping organizations understand market dynamics, consumer behavior and category evolution through social and commerce data.
By combining social listening, consumer research, category intelligence and commerce analysis, Buzzmetrics enables brands and agencies to uncover meaningful market signals, strategic insights and emerging opportunities across modern marketing environments.
We are looking for a Data Processing Leader detail-oriented, process-driven leader with strong problem-solving and communication skills to manage our data operations team and ensure flawless delivery of social listening projects.
The Data Processing Leader will oversee the end-to-end data workflow for social listening and social media research projects.
This role is responsible for managing workload allocation, ensuring data quality, building and standardizing QC processes, and acting as the primary liaison between the Data team, Research/Insights teams, and Technical stakeholders.
The Data Processing Leader plays a key role in ensuring that social data deliverables are accurate, timely, and aligned with client expectations.
JOB DESCRIPTION
1. Data Quality & Process Control
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability in tagging/sentiment.
Build and maintain QC frameworks, SOPs, and validation checklists.
Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring issues.
2. Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Collaboration
Act as the primary liaison between Data Ops, Research, and Tech
Troubleshoot data incidents (e.g., feed/API errors, duplicates, missing coverage).
Provide timely updates and communicate solutions to stakeholders.
3. Project & Team Management
Plan and allocate resources across multiple social listening projects.
Monitor workload, timelines, and delivery status to meet SLAs.
Lead, coach, and evaluate the performance of data analysts/QC staff.
4. Process Improvement & Automation
Identify bottlenecks and propose process optimizations.
Implement automation tools or scripts to improve efficiency.
Track and report operational KPIs to drive continuous improvement.
REQUIREMENTS
Education/ Knowledge:
Solid background in data operations, including workflow design, process documentation, and end-to-end data management (from ingestion to delivery).
Strong understanding of data quality frameworks: validation rules, QC sampling methods, and error classification.
Skills:
Project management: workload planning, timeline tracking, stakeholder coordination.
Excellent communication skills.
Problem-solving and decision-making under pressure.
Experiences:
5+ years in data operations / research operations, preferably within market research or social listening.
Minimum 1 year of team management experience.
Proven track record in delivering high-quality, large-scale data projects under tight deadlines.
Personality:
Detail-oriented and process-driven, with a focus on data accuracy and consistency.
Proactive mindset: anticipates problems and proposes solutions before escalation.
Strong stakeholder management skills: able to collaborate effectively across Research and Technical teams.
Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced
BENEFITS
Competitive salary
Premium healthcare insurance (for Upper Senior level)
12 days of annual leave & 5 days of sick leave
Standard health check
Company trip, Year end party, Team building
Occasion-based offerings: Birthday, wedding, maternity, …
Parking support
Equipment for work (Laptop)
Access comprehensive training to stay ahead in social media trends and tools, enhancing your skills for continued growth
Thrive in a fast-paced,dynamic environment where you’ll collaborate with teams across the company to solve challenges and drive innovation

full:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance.
Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
The Position
OPSWAT's data platform turns business-system data into governed, documented, tested tables that business teams can read without asking what a column means.
It is built on dbt Core, layered source → staging → intermediate → mart, and the warehouse is moving from Microsoft Fabric Warehouse to Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
You will learn the craft on the real thing: models that ship, with value parity proven before anything is cut over.
This is the entry point to analytics engineering on this team, and it is a working role rather than an observation one.
You will build models for the domains assigned to you and they will go into production.
What differs from a more senior role is the supervision, not the bar: every change is reviewed before it lands, you have a named mentor, and you are paired with a Product Analyst on the business side: the two halves answer for the same number.
By day 60 you are expected to be delivering a model with less correction than your first one, not to still be waiting for instructions.
What You Will Be Doing
Build staging, intermediate and mart dbt models for the domains assigned to you, following the team's layer standards: what belongs in each layer, where collation is normalised, one path in per source.
Write tests that fail when the data breaks, not checks that pass whatever the data does.
Run parity comparisons between a dbt model and the legacy procedure it replaces: execute the comparison, record the numbers, and learn what "proven" means before a consumer is repointed.
Investigate the quality failures your tests surface, and trace them back to the source instead of patching the symptom in the model.
Keep documentation and lineage current as models change, so the next reader does not have to ask what a column means.
Work across both engines while the warehouse migrates, and notice when the same model behaves differently on each.
Work in an AI-assisted engineering workflow. You set the task, review the output, and own what lands.
Pair with a Product Analyst to learn what the business needs from a number, and why a definition is worth arguing about.
Ask for review early, and act on it.
What we need from you
0–2 years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a comparable role or a portfolio that shows the same work.
Working SQL: joins, filters, aggregations, CTEs. Window functions are the next thing you learn, and you are already reading about them.
Some Python for data work. A script you wrote, a notebook you finished, a pipeline you broke and then fixed.
Git and pull-request basics, or the willingness to learn them in the first week.
The habit of checking your own numbers before sharing them: reconciliation, sanity checks, and saying so when something does not add up.
Curiosity about how the business actually works. You want to know why the data looks the way it does.
Willingness to ask for help early. On this team that is the norm, not a weakness.
It Would Be Great If You Also Have
Exposure to dbt, or another transformation framework, from coursework or a project.
A BI tool you have built in: Superset, Power BI, Looker, or similar.
A data project you can talk about for ten minutes: what it was for, what you got wrong, and what you changed.
Comfort in a terminal: Docker, a CLI, a cloud console.
Azure basics: storage, identity, or a service you have actually used
What success looks like in your first 60 days
Your first models are merged, reviewed, and pass the layer-standards check. You learned the rules by applying them.
A test you wrote catches something real, or would fail if the model broke.
You have run a parity comparison end to end and can explain what "proven" means without reading the definition back.
You can explain your domain's data in business terms, and why the definition matters.
Your reviewer's comments are getting fewer and smaller: the next model needs less correction than the first.

full:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Build and operate enterprise data platforms and pipelines that make structured and unstructured data usable by GenAI applications.
Bring strong data engineering skills, practical cloud experience and familiarity with AI tools.
Work with the existing Cloud, AI and Security teams to deliver reliable, scalable and cost-efficient solutions.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Build data pipelines. Implement ingestion, transformation and integration workflows; orchestrate scheduled or incremental processing, retries and recovery.
Develop data platforms. Implement lakehouse or warehouse solutions on the selected platform; structure data, schemas and metadata for reliable downstream use.
Prepare data for GenAI. Process enterprise documents, preserve source traceability and permissions, and connect data to embedding, indexing and retrieval services with AI engineers.
Integrate services. Connect LLM APIs and GenAI tools to data workflows and applications using the existing cloud environment and approved access patterns.
Improve quality and efficiency. Monitor data quality, pipeline failures, latency, throughput and cost; improve retrieval relevance with AI engineers against agreed examples.
Deliver maintainable systems. Version code and configuration, automate tests and releases, troubleshoot incidents, and document designs, runbooks and handover.
MUST HAVE - CORE REQUIREMENTS
Production data engineering. 5+ years in data engineering, data platforms or related software engineering, including hands-on delivery and support of production data pipelines.
Python, SQL and data design. Practical ETL/ELT, data modelling, orchestration, API integration, data quality checks and metadata management.
One data platform. Hands-on implementation with Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or an equivalent enterprise data platform; explain your own delivery contribution.
One cloud. Practical Azure, AWS or GCP experience for data workloads, including storage, service connectivity, identity/access and secrets management.
Engineering and AI fundamentals. Git, CI/CD, logs/metrics and troubleshooting; familiarity with LLM APIs and AI tools, plus understanding of RAG, embeddings and retrieval data flows.
Collaboration. Clear technical documentation and communication; relevant degree or equivalent practical engineering experience.
RAG delivery. Hands-on RAG solution development, including document chunking, embedding pipelines and integration of LLM services.
NICE TO HAVE - PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Vector and enterprise search. Vector database or enterprise search implementation; hybrid search, reranking and retrieval-quality evaluation.
GenAI operations. Prompt/configuration versioning, response evaluation, usage/cost monitoring or relevant cloud/data certifications.
DELIVERY SCOPE & HIRING PRIORITY
Own data-platform and pipeline delivery. Coordinate cloud provisioning and platform operations with the Cloud team, and apply controls agreed with Security and Governance specialists.
Suggested assessment weighting: 60% data engineering/platform delivery;
25% practical cloud, integration and operations;
15% GenAI/RAG experience.
Assess one delivered project, the candidate’s contribution and troubleshooting decisions.
Preferred skills add value; core requirements remain the selection basis.
BENEFITS:
Competitive salary package with 100% salary during probation
Full social insurance contribution based on your actual salary
Annual performance bonus and salary review.
Premium healthcare insurance for employees and eligible family members from probation.
Annual health check-up.
Company-sponsored training programs, professional courses, and certification exams.
Generous leave policy with 36+ paid leave days per year (annual leave, medical leave, exam leave, etc.) and public holidays in accordance with regulations.
Hybrid working model and flexible working hours.
Global working environment with opportunities to collaborate with international teams.
Clear career development roadmap and long-term growth opportunities.
Supportive culture that promotes work-life balance.
WORK SCHEDULE:
Monday to Friday, 08:00 – 12:00 and 13:00 – 17:00.
Hybrid working mode (up to 2 days/week)
Flexible start hours between 7:45 AM and 9:00 AM with manager approval.
WORK LOCATIONS:
Ha Noi: HITC Building, No. 239 Xuan Thuy Street, Cau Giay Ward, Hanoi City
Ho Chi Minh City: Opal Office Tower, 92 Nguyen Huu Canh Street, Ho Chi Minh City.

Responsibilities
Research alpha signals from price, volume, sentiment, and alternative datasets
Build systematic models using statistics, machine learning, or reinforcement learning
Backtest rigorously and optimize for Sharpe, drawdown, and stability
Collaborate with engineering to deploy strategies into live trading environments
Requirements

full:
Mô tả công việc:
Thu thập, xử lý, phân tích và trực quan hóa dữ liệu từ nhiều nguồn khác nhau để hỗ trợ ra quyết định kinh doanh.
Thiết kế, xây dựng và duy trì các pipeline dữ liệu để thu thập, xử lý và lưu trữ dữ liệu.
Xây dựng và duy trì các báo cáo, dashboard, và công cụ phân tích dữ liệu.
Đảm bảo tính toàn vẹn, bảo mật và chất lượng của dữ liệu trong hệ thống.
Tích hợp các nguồn dữ liệu và triển khai các giải pháp lưu trữ dữ liệu (Data Warehouse, Data Lake).
Phối hợp với các nhóm liên quan để triển khai các dự án phân tích và kỹ thuật dữ liệu.
Giám sát hiệu suất hệ thống dữ liệu và thực hiện các cải tiến để tối ưu hóa.
Yêu cầu:
Tốt nghiệp đại học chuyên ngành liên quan như Khoa học dữ liệu, Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, hoặc Kinh tế.
Có kinh nghiệm từ 2-5 năm trong lĩnh vực phân tích dữ liệu hoặc kỹ sư dữ liệu.
Ưu tiên ứng viên có chứng chỉ liên quan đến công nghệ và phân tích dữ liệu (VD: Google Data Analytics, AWS Certified Data Analytics).
Thành thạo các ngôn ngữ lập trình như Python, SQL, Java hoặc Scala.
Ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm làm việc với các công nghệ Big Data như Hadoop, Spark, Kafka.
Hiểu biết về các hệ thống cơ sở dữ liệu quan hệ (RDBMS) và NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra).
Kinh nghiệm triển khai và quản lý các giải pháp lưu trữ dữ liệu (ETL, Data Warehouse, Data Lake).
Kỹ năng sử dụng các công cụ phân tích dữ liệu như Power BI, Tableau là một lợi thế
Hiểu biết về các mô hình thống kê, phân tích dự đoán và học máy (machine learning) là một lợi thế.
Kỹ năng làm việc với các công cụ điện toán đám mây như AWS, Azure, hoặc Google Cloud Platform.
Khả năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề kỹ thuật phức tạp.
Tư duy logic, khả năng giải quyết vấn đề và làm việc nhóm hiệu quả.
Quyền lợi:
Mức lương cạnh tranh, lương tháng 13 và thưởng theo hiệu quả công việc (Performance Bonus).
Xem xét điều chỉnh lương và đánh giá hiệu quả công việc hằng năm.
15 ngày phép và 01 ngày nghỉ sinh nhật
Được tham gia các khóa đào tạo nâng cao của Techcombank.
Lộ trình phát triển nghề nghiệp rõ ràng, cùng sự hỗ trợ sát sao từ đội ngũ quản lý.
Được hưởng chế độ chăm sóc toàn diện như: bảo hiểm/chăm sóc sức khỏe cá nhân, khám sức khỏe định kỳ, quà sinh nhật từ ngân hàng, teambuilding, tiệc cuối năm, v.v.
Được cung cấp đầy đủ công cụ và trang thiết bị cần thiết cho công việc.
Tham gia các khóa đào tạo chuyên môn nghiệp vụ.

full:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users.
We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products.
Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more.
Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.
What You’ll Do
Responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines to support Square team’s data and feature engineering needs.
Lead feature data preparation, transformation, validation, and monitoring for machine learning and recommendation/search systems.
Collaborate closely with algorithm, product, and business teams to translate business requirements into reliable data and feature solutions.
Drive the development of core data infrastructure and feature platforms with data-driven strategies to maximize business impact.
Ensure data quality, stability, and performance across offline and online feature pipelines.
Identify data gaps and optimization opportunities, and define success metrics together with Product and Business stakeholders.
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or related fields, with 5+ years of relevant industry experience.
Strong hands-on experience in data engineering, including large-scale data processing, ETL/ELT pipelines, and feature engineering.
Expert-level proficiency in Java and Scala.
Solid experience with big data technologies (e.g. Spark, Hive, Flink, or similar distributed systems).
Familiar with machine learning feature lifecycle, including offline training features and online serving features.
Experience working with data warehouses and feature stores is a strong plus.
Bilingual English and Chinese are required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.
Strong ownership, communication skills, and ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Why Binance
Shape the future of finance
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Competitive salary and company benefits
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information.
These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment.
Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

full:
Overview
About Our Partner
Our partner is Australia’s only dedicated B2B credit reporting agency, and one of the country’s most innovative fintech success stories.
We help Australian businesses of all sizes - from sole traders and family-run operators to ASX listed enterprises - reduce risk, get paid faster and trade with confidence.
Our platform helps businesses see financial trouble coming early enough to do something about it.
By predicting failure before it happens, we empower our customers to protect revenue, safeguard cash flow and grow with confidence.
We offer a complete suite of credit reporting and risk management solutions across the entire customer lifecycle - from onboarding and automated credit decisioning through to ongoing monitoring, PPSR registrations, UBO/KYC reporting and automated collections.
Trusted by thousands of businesses across every industry and region in Australia, CreditorWatch sits at the centre of the country’s B2B economy, providing the data, insights and technology that keep trade moving.
Our Purpose:
Empower Australian businesses to trade confidently with their customers.
Our Mission:
We aim to be number one in our industry by delivering unique data insights and innovative products.
Position Overview:
The Senior Data Engineer plays a key role in designing and delivering scalable, high-performance data solutions.
This role takes ownership of complex technical components like data pipelines, data and machine learning models, mentors junior engineers, and partners closely with stakeholders to ensure data platforms support product and business needs.
Responsibilities
Some of your responsibilities include and are not limited to:
Design, build and operate data products that serve the CreditorWatch/Collect applications, and internal analytics teams
Own data solutions end to end - source integration through to the interface apps and analytics consumers
Contribute to the data platform on Databricks - Lakeflow pipelines, Unity Catalog governance, Databricks apps with Lakebase backend
Build and extend transformation layers in dbt core, with testability and clear ownership
Use Claude Code or similar Agentic AI coding tools and Databricks Agent Skills as a core part of the development workflow with accountability for quality
Partner with product, analytics and software engineering teams on how data products are consumed by the broader CW stack
Mentor DEs via code reviews, pairing and technical guidance
Contribute to architectural decisions, platform standards and continuous improvement
Qualifications
Competencies (essential behaviours required for the role):
Strong expertise in SQL and Python, with track record of delivering production-grade data solutions
Experience with modern data platforms and tools such as Databricks, dbt and cloud data warehouses
Strong understanding of data modelling and storage patterns for analytical and operational use cases
Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally AWS
Understanding of data security, governance and access control principles
Experience serving data into customer-facing applications, not only analytics / reporting layers
Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Databricks Agent Skills) as day-to-day workflow
Clear written and verbal communication, especially when working across time zones with teams in Australia
Good English communication skills (both verbal & written), especially in the global software development environment.
Due to the large number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Company Description VietQuant Technologies is a quantitative trading firm that applies a scientific and rules-based approach to investing.
The firm focuses on identifying stock factors and characteristics that are expected to outperform the broader market over the long term.
VietQuant develops and implements systematic financial strategies built on a proprietary research platform.
A robust risk management process underpins all investment decisions, supporting disciplined portfolio construction.
Team members collaborate in a data-driven environment that values rigor, innovation, and transparency.
Role Description The Quantitative Researcher will design, test, and refine systematic investment strategies using statistical and mathematical models.
Day-to-day responsibilities include collecting and cleaning financial and alternative data, performing exploratory data analysis, and conducting empirical research to evaluate factors and signals for quantitative investing.
The role involves implementing research prototypes, backtesting strategies, and documenting methodology and results for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
The Quantitative Researcher will work closely with portfolio managers and engineers to bring research into production, monitor live strategies, and contribute to continuous improvement of the proprietary research platform.
.
Qualifications
Candidates should possess strong foundations in Statistics and Mathematics, with experience applying these disciplines to real-world data.
Candidates should possess skills in Quantitative Research and Quantitative Investing, including model development, factor analysis, and backtesting.
Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills for handling large datasets, identifying patterns, and drawing robust, data-driven conclusions.
Relevant qualifications include proficiency in programming languages commonly used in quantitative finance (such as Python, R, or MATLAB) and familiarity with databases and data pipelines.
Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s or advanced degree in a quantitative field (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or Economics) and experience or interest in financial markets.
Relevant qualifications include strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, ability to work collaboratively on-site, and a commitment to rigorous, ethical research practices.

ST Engineering is a leading global technology, defense, and engineering conglomerate headquartered in Singapore.
Established in 1997, the company has grown into a powerhouse, offering innovative solutions across aerospace, defense, urban solutions, and satellite communications.
With a strong presence in over 50 cities worldwide, ST Engineering delivers cutting-edge technologies to industries such as aerospace, defense, and smart cities.
The company is committed to creating sustainable solutions that address both current and future challenges.
Backed by a dedicated workforce, ST Engineering continues to lead in providing mission-critical systems and services to customers around the world.
Visit us at: https://www.stengg.com/
Responsibilities
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports, and help business users get answers without always coming back to the analytics team.
Build and tune data models and pipelines across SAP Datasphere and our AWS stack (Glue, Athena, Redshift).
Work directly with business units to understand what they need, agree on the right metrics, and turn that into something useful.
Use advanced analytics and AI/ML where it earns its place: forecasting, segmentation, anomaly detection, predictive models.
Keep data quality and definitions consistent across reports so people trust the numbers.
Tune queries and keep cloud processing costs sensible.
Mentor junior analysts and raise the bar on how the team works.
Partner with the data engineering and AI teams to get models into production and into day-to-day workflows.

Degree in data science, computer science, statistics, engineering, or similar.
At least 2~3 years experiences in Data Analyst focusing on PowerBI/MCP/AI skills
Strong Power BI skills: DAX, Power Query, data modelling, dashboard design.
Hands-on with SAP Datasphere (or SAP BW/HANA) for enterprise data modelling.
Good working knowledge of AWS data tools (Glue, Athena, Redshift) and ELT pipeline design.
Strong SQL and solid Python for analysis and automation.
A good grasp of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, and ELT/ETL.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience applying AI/ML or generative AI to real analytics problems.
Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and security.
Cloud cost optimisation and performance tuning experience.
Certifications like Microsoft PL-300, AWS Data Analytics, or SAP.
Experience in a regulated or large enterprise setting.

About the company
We are a creative growth accelerator made up of creatives, designers, technologists, strategists, and data scientists.
We work with ambitious, world class clients who are as committed to shaping culture and defining the future as we are.
We currently have more than 1000 employees working globally across North America, Latin America, Europe, and Asia.
About Technology
Technology at company is powered by a global practice of creative technologists, spanning Engineers, QA specialists, Business Analysts, Data Scientists and ML Architects.
We combine deep engineering rigor with innovation at the edge of agentic AI, modern data stacks and cloud infrastructure.
We engineer the intelligent systems that turn audacious strategic vision into production-ready reality.
The role
Company is looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data practice.
You will build and maintain the pipelines and data models behind client analytics, personalization and AI products.
You will work within architecture and standards set by the Lead Data Engineer and partner with Data Scientists, Product and Strategy teams.
Your work will include preparing data for agentic AI applications and using AI agents in your own engineering workflow.
What you’ll do

full:
ABOUT BUZZMETRICS
Buzzmetrics, a member of YouNet Group, is a leading Social Media & E-commerce Market Research company for Marketing Systems.
Since 2013, Buzzmetrics has pioneered the application of market research methodologies to social media and digital environments, helping organizations understand market dynamics, consumer behavior and category evolution through social and commerce data.
By combining social listening, consumer research, category intelligence and commerce analysis, Buzzmetrics enables brands and agencies to uncover meaningful market signals, strategic insights and emerging opportunities across modern marketing environments.
We are looking for a Data Processing Leader detail-oriented, process-driven leader with strong problem-solving and communication skills to manage our data operations team and ensure flawless delivery of social listening projects.
The Data Processing Leader will oversee the end-to-end data workflow for social listening and social media research projects.
This role is responsible for managing workload allocation, ensuring data quality, building and standardizing QC processes, and acting as the primary liaison between the Data team, Research/Insights teams, and Technical stakeholders.
The Data Processing Leader plays a key role in ensuring that social data deliverables are accurate, timely, and aligned with client expectations.
JOB DESCRIPTION
1. Data Quality & Process Control
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability in tagging/sentiment.
Build and maintain QC frameworks, SOPs, and validation checklists.
Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring issues.
2. Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Collaboration
Act as the primary liaison between Data Ops, Research, and Tech
Troubleshoot data incidents (e.g., feed/API errors, duplicates, missing coverage).
Provide timely updates and communicate solutions to stakeholders.
3. Project & Team Management
Plan and allocate resources across multiple social listening projects.
Monitor workload, timelines, and delivery status to meet SLAs.
Lead, coach, and evaluate the performance of data analysts/QC staff.
4. Process Improvement & Automation
Identify bottlenecks and propose process optimizations.
Implement automation tools or scripts to improve efficiency.
Track and report operational KPIs to drive continuous improvement.
REQUIREMENTS
Education/ Knowledge:
Solid background in data operations, including workflow design, process documentation, and end-to-end data management (from ingestion to delivery).
Strong understanding of data quality frameworks: validation rules, QC sampling methods, and error classification.
Skills:
Project management: workload planning, timeline tracking, stakeholder coordination.
Excellent communication skills.
Problem-solving and decision-making under pressure.
Experiences:
5+ years in data operations / research operations, preferably within market research or social listening.
Minimum 1 year of team management experience.
Proven track record in delivering high-quality, large-scale data projects under tight deadlines.
Personality:
Detail-oriented and process-driven, with a focus on data accuracy and consistency.
Proactive mindset: anticipates problems and proposes solutions before escalation.
Strong stakeholder management skills: able to collaborate effectively across Research and Technical teams.
Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced
BENEFITS
Competitive salary
Premium healthcare insurance (for Upper Senior level)
12 days of annual leave & 5 days of sick leave
Standard health check
Company trip, Year end party, Team building
Occasion-based offerings: Birthday, wedding, maternity, …
Parking support
Equipment for work (Laptop)
Access comprehensive training to stay ahead in social media trends and tools, enhancing your skills for continued growth
Thrive in a fast-paced,dynamic environment where you’ll collaborate with teams across the company to solve challenges and drive innovation

full:
About The Role
We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with strong machine learning expertise, analytical thinking, and business understanding to join our R&D team.
You will take ownership of key machine learning initiatives, particularly conversion prediction (CPA optimization), CTR prediction, and bidding optimization.
The role focuses on translating business challenges into practical ML solutions, improving advertising performance, and maintaining existing ML models in production.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, and optimize machine learning models, particularly CTR/CVR prediction
Understand business objectives and translate them into actionable ML solutions that deliver measurable impact
Analyze advertising performance, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities for improvement
Design experiments and evaluate model effectiveness using both ML metrics and business KPIs
Take ownership of existing ML projects, ensuring their continuous improvement and reliability in production
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Engineers, and business teams to drive ML initiatives
Requirements
Must Have
4+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning, preferably with production ML experience
Experience solving real-world ML problems in AdTech, FinTech, or similar domains, particularly those involving incomplete, delayed, or biased labels
Strong knowledge of ML algorithms, feature engineering, model evaluation, and optimization
Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn, XGBoost, or LightGBM
Strong business understanding and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect ML solutions to business outcomes
Ability to independently own ML projects, investigate issues, and drive improvements
Good English communication and collaboration skills
Nice to Have
Experience in RTB, CTR/CVR prediction, CPA optimization
Knowledge of A/B testing, model calibration, and online experimentation
Experience with large-scale data processing and production ML systems
Familiarity with LLMs and AI coding assistants
What We Value
We value someone who understands not only how to build models, but also why they matter to the business — a proactive problem solver who takes ownership and focuses on real-world impact.
Benefits
Competitive remuneration package including quarterly bonus and performance review opportunities
Full participation in mandatory insurance programs in accordance with Vietnamese Labor Law
Healthcare insurance package and annual health check-up
Comprehensive benefits scheme such as W3F (Work, Wellbeing, Welfare) Fund for courses, materials, personal health and wellbeing
Work from home benefits
You will have the advance to influence and drive the changes, at Knorex we welcome good ideas and accept any possibility to make our company great
We offer great learning opportunities; you will have exposure to cutting edge performance marketing and advertising technology
Opportunity to work cross-country and with a variety of projects of a different nature

Established in 2017, FPT Long Châu Pharmacy has grown to over 2,000 locations nationwide, providing high-quality healthcare products and services.
Our pharmacies feature modern, GPP-standard equipment, and a dedicated team committed to community health.
Our future vision includes becoming the largest, most modern pharmacy chain in Vietnam, offering the best customer experience and being the premier workplace for our staff.

Working hours: Monday to Friday (08:30 AM – 06:00 PM)
Job Description
Extract, process, and analyze data from core business systems (sales, marketing, customer care, …) to answer business questions and drive decisions.
Build and optimize operation dashboards and analytical reports in Power BI and Superset to support decision-making across business units
Query and model data on Databricks (Spark SQL, Delta/Unity Catalog) to support deep-dive analysis beyond descriptive reporting.

Identify insights, trends, and anomalies in data, and proactively propose data-driven solutions to stakeholders.
Work directly with Business teams to understand requirements and translate them into actionable analysis.
Collaborate with Data engineers to ensure stable infrastructure, and with Analysts/BUs to ensure data is accurate, well-documented, and easy to consume.
Requirements
At least 3 years of experience in Data Analytics, BI, or Analytics Engineering.
Strong SQL skills (CTEs, window functions) with hands-on experience in Databricks/Spark SQL.
Experience building professional dashboards in Power BI (advanced DAX) and/or Superset.
Solid analytical thinking: descriptive statistics, customer segmentation, cohort/funnel analysis.
Experience or familiarity with the healthcare/pharma domain (vaccines, clinical services, pharmacy retail) is a strong plus.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to present insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
